senses.gloss: क्लिन्दत् mfn. (√ 2. क्लिन्द्) wet, Mudr. iii, 20.
क्लिन्न mfn. moistened, wet, MBh.; R. &c.
running (as an eye), Pāṇ. v, 2, 33, Vārtt. 2
rotted, putrefied, Car. i, 11 and 27; Lalit. xii
soft, moved (the heart), BhP. iv, 3, 10 and ix, 11, 5
क्लिन्न m. N. of a Śākta author of Mantras
क्लिन्न See ib.
क्लिन्ना f. the plant Solanum diffusum, L.
क्लिन्न—त्व n. the being wet, Suśr.
क्लिन्न—नेत्र mfn. having running eyes, L.
having moist eyes, pitiful, L.
क्लिन्न—वर्त्मन् n. excess of the lachrymal discharge, watering of the eyes, Suśr.
क्लिन्न—हृद् mfn. tender-hearted.
क्लिन्नाक्ष mfn. having moist eyes, blear-eyed, L.
क्लिन्नक mfn. moistened a little Comm. on Gobh. ii, 1, 10.
क्लिन्नक See ib.
1. क्लिन्द् cl. 1. P. Ā. क्लिन्दति, ˚ते, to lament, Dhātup. ii, 14; iii, 36 (cf. √ क्लन्द्.)
2. क्लिन्द् pr.p. ˚दत्. See √ क्लिद्.
क्लि॑ब् f. (v.l., कॢब्; √ कॢप्?) accomplishment [‘the created world’, Sāy.] VS. xl, 15; ŚBr. xiv, 8, 3, 1.

क्लीब् cl. 1. Ā. क्लिबते, to be impotent, behave like a eunuch, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 11; Pat.;
to be timorous or modest or unassuming, Dhātup. x, 18 : cl. 10. Ā. क्लीबयते, to be unmanly or timorous, MBh. vi, 4334 (v.l.), Kathās. civ, 126.
क्लिशित mfn. molested, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 50.
क्लिशित—वत् mfn. suffering pain or distress, W.
क्लिश्यमान mfn. being distressed, MBh.; R.
क्लिष्ट mfn. (Pāṇ. vii, 2, 50) molested, tormented, afflicted, distressed, R.; Mālav.; Śak. &c.
wearied, hurt, injured, being in bad condition, worn, R.; Śak.; Megh.; Suśr.
connected with pain or suffering, KapS. ii, 33; Yogas.; Pañcat.
(in rhet.) forced, obscure, not easily intelligible (cf. √ क्लेश्), Sāh.; Pratāpar.; Vām. ii, 1, 21 ff.
क्लिष्टम् ind. in distress, BhP. i, 9, 12.
क्लिष्ट—त्व n. obscurity (of a passage), Sāh.
क्लिष्ट—वर्त्मन् n. a disease of the eyelids (cf. क्लिन्न-व्˚), Suśr. vi, 3, 16.
क्लिष्ट—वृत्ति mfn. leading a wretched life, Kathās. iii, 14.
क्लिष्टि f. affliction, distress, L.
service, L.
क्लीत m. a kind of venomous insect, Suśr. v, 8, 9.
क्लीतक mfn. (grains) prepared as dough or paste, Gobh. ii, 1, 10
क्लीतक n. dough or paste (ifc.), ĀśvGṛ. iii, 8, 8
(prepared from sweet root), Bhpr.
Glycyrrhiza glabra or echinata (sweet root), Car. i, 1
क्लीतक m. or n. N. of a plant with a poisonous root, Suśr. v, 2, 3.
क्लीतका f. id., ĀpŚr. xv, 3, 16
क्लीतकिका f. the Indigo plant (काल-क्लीतक), L.
क्लीतनक n. a variety of the sweet root plant, L.
क्लीतनायक n. id., L.
क्लीतनी f. the Indigo plant, L.
क्लीब॑ mf(आ॑)n. (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 11, Vārtt. 3) impotent, emasculated, a eunuch, AV.; VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
unmanly, timorous, weak, idle, a coward, MBh.; Mṛcch.; BhP. &c.
having no water (as a cloud), Daś.
(in lexicography) of the neuter gender
क्लीब॑ (अम्), n. (in lexicography) the neuter gender.
क्लीब॑—ता f. impotence, Suśr.
weakness (as of a grass), ŚārṅgP.
(अ-क्˚, ‘manliness’, Ragh. viii, 83)
the being neuter.
क्लीब॑—त्व n. impotence, MBh. ii, 1457.
क्लीब॑—योग m. N. of a particular constellation, VarBṛ.
क्लीब॑—रूप (˚ब॑-), mfn. similar to a eunuch, AV. viii, 6, 7.
क्लीब—लिङ्ग n. the neuter gender, W.
क्लीब—वत् ind. like a base man, like a weak-minded or effeminate person.
क्लीबाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to behave like a eunuch, Vop. xxi, 7.

क्लीव for क्लीब, q.v.
